subject: MSBA School Building Committee Resolution
overview: The Medford School Committee held a special meeting to review, amend, and adopt Resolution 2024-10. The resolution establishes the governance structure, educational goals, membership composition, and application process for the Massachusetts School Building Authority (MSBA) School Building Committee.

items.title: Meeting Opening and Zoom Guidelines
items.summary: Member Graham provided instructions for public participation via Zoom and email.

items.title: Overview of Resolution 2024-10
items.summary: Member Graham introduced Resolution 2024-10 establishing a school building committee to shepherd the district through the MSBA process.

items.title: Regulatory Framework Reading
items.summary: The committee voted to waive the reading of the statutory regulatory background section of the resolution.

items.title: Building Committee Goals
items.summary: The committee approved amended project goals, incorporating CHIPS green building standards alongside LEED certification and correcting the formal name of Curtis Tufts High School.

items.title: Authority and Membership Structure
items.summary: The committee approved amendments establishing 15 voting positions and designated non-voting administrative positions, including adding Curtis Tufts High School Principal Dr. Lori Hodgdon as a non-voting member.

items.title: Application Form and Requirements
items.summary: The committee approved the community application form and eligibility requirements after adding contact information fields and clarifying staff applicant categories.

items.title: Timeline and Final Adoption of Resolution 2024-10
items.summary: The committee approved Resolution 2024-10 as amended, setting the schedule for application reviews and targeting May 1, 2024, for the building committee's first meeting.
